basic_info.description: 857 Castro Street, San Francisco New Price! Stunning Eureka Valley 4 bd/3 ba contemporary home at the top of Castro! Ground-up rebuild. Open flr plan, 10' ceilings, 8' drs. New mech systems: heat, plumbing, electrical, foundation & seismic upgrades. Skylights & dbl-pane windows. Main flr opens to sunny patio & garden. Recessed lights. Rift-cut white oak flrs. Chef's kitchen w/ island, Thermador pro gas range, vented hood, & Liebherr refrigerator. Caesarstone counters, white oak cabinets, glass & stone tile. Large master w/ en-suite bath, dbl vanity, tiled shower, & soaking tub. Laundry hook-ups on BR level. Full baths on both floors. Spacious closets. Wired for cable, alarm, data, & A/V w/speakers. 2 car pkg w/ interior access & wine cellar. Access to private tech buses & 24th St!
